weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.title: Administration system
weeks.description: AIM logs in and adds, edits and publishes a real vehicle without assistance.

items.text: Secure staff login — `/admin/login`, password via Supabase Auth, session refreshed in `proxy.ts`
Multi-factor authentication enforced for admin roles — any aal1 session is sent to `/admin/mfa`; enrol or verify, no skip
Role-aware admin layout and navigation — permission set read from `role_permissions`, staff check against `profiles`
Add, edit and publish vehicles with no developer involvement — tabbed form: Identity, Specs, Pricing, Photos, Costs, Documents, Status
Multi-image upload with drag-to-reorder — signed upload URLs straight to Storage, order written in one call
Duplicate Vehicle — `fn_duplicate_vehicle()` copies the listing as a draft with VIN, stock number, odometer, prices cleared; photos copied
Full lifecycle: Draft, Coming Soon, Active, Reserved, Sold, Archived — transition table in `lib/vehicles/status.ts`, DB trigger backstop
Featured and New Arrival controls governing homepage content — Pricing tab (homepage rewiring to read them is Week 3)
Sold archive with recorded sale prices — `/admin/vehicles/sold`; sale price required when marking Sold
Vehicle cost entry with landed cost, gross profit, margin, return on cost — from `v_vehicle_financials`
Cost and profit visible only to Owner and Accounts — Costs tab absent for Staff; the policy refuses regardless
Document attachment against vehicles and customers, privately stored — private bucket, 60-second signed URLs
Trade-in records with internal valuation fields — `/admin/trade-ins`, staff-recorded walk-ins plus the Week 6 web form
Convert to Stock — `fn_convert_trade_in()`: one transaction creates the vehicle, copies photos, links customer, records acquisition cost where permitted
Staff invitations from the Team page (Owner only), password setup and reset flows
Unit tests for form schemas, money, lifecycle and storage paths (`npm test`, 21 checks)
Acceptance suite run against the live project and test data reviewed by AIM, then removed
Deployed to Vercel (syd1) and connected to the live Sydney Supabase project — https://aimprestige.vercel.app (2026-09-13)

First Owner account created and MFA enrolled (2026-09-13); admin walk passed locally against the live project for vehicles, photos, costs, documents, lifecycle, duplicate and trade-in conversion. Staff invitation by email still to be tested.
Week 2 acceptance walk completed by AIM unassisted (criteria 1, 7, 15, 21)
Week 2 review confirmed by AIM in writing

weeks.label: Week 4
weeks.title: Freight and delivery
weeks.description: AIM enters carrier rates and a customer receives a delivery price by postcode.

items.text: Base transport rates by route and postcode — `/admin/freight/rates`, zone to zone with optional vehicle size; one live rate per route + size
Postcode zone and regional grouping configuration — `/admin/freight/zones` and `/admin/freight/postcodes`; every Australian postcode band seeded to a zone (migration 0016)
Regional and remote surcharges — `/admin/freight/surcharges`, per zone or postcode, dollar and/or percent
Vehicle size categories where different rates apply — size on each rate, size on each vehicle (Specs tab), size-less rate as the fallback
Markup configurable as percentage or fixed dollar amount — freight settings, plus rounding rule and quote-only message
Individual route overrides, special rates, temporary manual overrides — `/admin/freight/overrides`, postcode / zone / vehicle, dated validity, quote-only option
Contact-us-for-quote designation for unpriced locations — quote-only zones, postcodes and overrides; any route with no rate falls back to the configured message
CSV and Excel bulk upload with validation preview — `/admin/freight/uploads`: parse, validate every row, preview accepted and rejected, apply in one transaction, revert
Carrier cost and customer price stored separately — `delivery_quotes` keeps both; margin in `v_delivery_margin`
Delivery calculator on every vehicle page — postcode in, price or quote-only out; carrier cost never leaves the database
Coverage across all Australian states and territories — 8 states and territories, metro / regional / remote zones, 6,000+ postcodes
AIM's carrier rate sheet loaded — **hard blocker**, not yet requested from AIM; until it arrives every postcode returns the quote-only message
Deployed and verified on production 2026-09-13 — 131/131 database checks live (26 freight), `npm run test:e2e` 67/67, Week 3 regression 72/72
Week 4 review confirmed by AIM in writing
